a: A write that animateOnSetPose passes straight through leaves a running no-poseTarget glide on, which writes over it next frame
Baking a skinned node writes its world-space bent path into `data.path`, so a rotated node gets its rotation applied twice
animateLifecycle re-inserting a node whose exit is still running inserts a node the scene still holds
placeSkeleton / unplaceSkeleton place root joints by the pose's full frame but turn them by the descriptor's rotation only
b: animateLifecycle: re-inserting a node whose exit is still running inserts an id the scene still holds, which a scene-backed adapter refuses
coastOnTargets: a flick with no riders never ends, so its coast stays registered and its animator watch is never removed
